authority.available_windows: Only this tool may authorize a window offered to the user.
authority.delivery_record: This state is authoritative for the scheduled window.
authority.reschedule_events: This event history is authoritative for commit count.
authority.get_reschedule_status: This tool resolves or exposes uncertainty after a timeout.

rules: Offer only windows returned by available_windows.
Commit at most one reschedule event per user request.
Reuse one controller-owned idempotency key across retries.
After a timeout, call get_reschedule_status before describing the result.
Claim confirmed only when the delivery record shows the requested window.
Escalate when operation status remains malformed or undecidable.

local_limits.note: A fictional product requirement, not a general recommendation.
